notes.title: Major update to the Network!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40259333/4d2e88cf53e1f3ab74f27abf56742e61e5eb9718.png[/img]
A major update for Network has been released, containing additional content!

[b]What has changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new storyline;

[*] Added a new chapter;

[*] Added new locations;

[*] Fixed bugs on the level with the race;

[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]
